title: Unchecked PAX extension data bypasses the positive archive boundary and bounded parsing
contract: ADR 0033 exact allowed source/generated metadata; minimal-sdist-design membership and archive safety before extraction; fail closed for unexpected logs/receipts.
minimal_counterexample: Valid eight-file synthetic sdist with a per-file PAX header review.hidden_log holding 10 MiB of repeated A bytes. No product member bytes change.
observed: check_sdist and CLI accept. compressed_bytes=10758, unpacked_bytes=166, member_count=8, although gzip.decompress produces 10496000 bytes including a 10485760-byte unknown PAX value.
expected: Reject unapproved extension metadata and constrain decompressed header parsing before allocating/reading arbitrary extension payloads.
root_cause: tarfile consumes and materializes extended headers before yielding TarInfo; the validator examines only yielded logical members, never pax_headers or a bounded decompressed stream.
acceptance_conditions: Inventory backend-produced PAX metadata and permit only narrowly required keys/values.
Cap total decompressed input/header bytes during parsing without changing the documented regular-file logical byte metric.
Reject this counterexample before extraction and preserve failed receipt/nonzero exit; keep valid backend artifacts passing.
scope: The observed regular-file logical-byte total is accurate; the defect is unclassified extension data and unbounded parsing, not a claim that PAX data is a regular file.

title: The gate accepts malformed gzip framing and an unchecked appended archive
contract: ADR 0033 exact archive membership, archive safety and fail-closed inspection before extraction; unexpected verification logs must not enter product artifact.
minimal_counterexample: Append a second gzip-compressed tar containing docs/hidden-evidence.log (10 MiB) after a valid sdist. Separately zero or remove the original gzip trailer.
observed: All variants return status passed. Concatenated archive compressed_bytes=10770 and reported unpacked_bytes=166/member_count=8 while decompressed total is10506240 bytes. Corrupt CRC, missing trailer and malformed second gzip stream are independently rejected by gzip.decompress but accepted by check_sdist.
expected: Consume and verify the complete compressed stream/trailer, reject malformed framing and any additional non-padding tar payload/member stream not covered by the inventory.
root_cause: tarfile iteration terminates at the first tar end marker. Closing the read archive does not force gzip EOF/trailer verification or inspect trailing streams.
acceptance_conditions: Add bounded full gzip integrity/framing validation.
Reject non-padding content after the one allowed tar archive, including an appended second archive.
Preserve finite budgets, nonzero rejection and failed receipt; distinguish harmless defined tar padding from an additional payload.

title: Standalone generated metadata validation accepts invalid version syntax and duplicate identity headers
contract: ADR 0033 explicitly checked generated PKG-INFO; complete metadata validation.
minimal_counterexample: Replace Metadata-Version: 2.4 with Metadata-Version: garbage, or append a second Name: attacker header after Name: repo-catalog while preserving all frozen source inputs.
observed: check_sdist and standalone CLI return status passed/exit0 for both malformed PKG-INFO examples.
expected: Reject malformed metadata versions and duplicate singleton identity fields rather than treating nonempty first-match fields as valid generated metadata.
root_cause: BytesParser().get returns the first matching header; code checks only truthiness of Metadata-Version and first Name/Version.
acceptance_conditions: Validate supported core metadata version syntax and required singleton header cardinality.
Retain exact PKG-INFO versus wheel METADATA equality in integrated builds.
Add standalone-gate regressions for malformed and duplicate fields.
scope: Integrated compare_wheels checks exact PKG-INFO/METADATA equality and would reject these altered standalone sdists when paired with a legitimate wheel. No claim that the real generated artifact has malformed metadata.
